relationships.subject: senolytics
relationships.evidence_quote: Remarkably, mice treated with senolytic agents exhibited significantly less or no signs of mechanical pain 4 weeks post nerve injury when compared with baseline or vehicle at the same timepoint (Fig. 5b).

relationships.subject: nociceptor senescence
relationships.evidence_quote: We discovered that senescence of a small subset of pain-sensing neurons may be a driver of chronic pain.

relationships.subject: p53 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: The presence of these genes together strongly suggested a process of cellular senescence during pain chronification29–31.

key_findings: The iPain single-cell atlas of DRG/TG shows increased senescence (SenMayo score, SA-β-Gal, p21) in nociceptors after nerve injury, and in human DRG from chronic pain and diabetic neuropathy patients.
Senolytic Bcl-2 family inhibitors reduced mechanical pain 4 weeks after chronic constriction injury in mice.
